purpose: Freeze the semantic class boundaries and residual routing policy before the final fresh holdout.
principles: A named recipient, company, team or sales department does not by itself make a purpose concrete.
Concrete requires an explicit observable outcome or service in the same form text.
Generic contact, registration, subscription or submission remains generic when no additional outcome is visible.
Try for free without a visible object or creation outcome is ambiguous and remains unknown.
Pure technical or structural UI text can be none; semantic text that cannot be resolved remains unknown.
The router never emits concrete deterministically. Non-trivial semantic cases are delegated to the intent LLM.

reference_overrides.reason: General help/contact text without a specific observable outcome. This aligns with framework 0.7 and QA7-019.
Try for free is an isolated action when the object or creation outcome is not visible in the same form.
Talk to a named company is still contact; the recipient is not the purpose outcome.
Sales contact and sending a sales/general question remain generic without a specific service outcome such as quote, demo or appointment.
